# Execution quality: session review

To review a different session, change the notebook variable **`@day`** (currently `'2026-11-11'`; `'$yesterday'` also works). Panel 5 always covers every day in the database.

Markout = signed move of the venue mid from our fill price, in bps: `sign(qty) * (mid(t+h) - px) / px`. **Negative means the market moved against us after we traded.** Exchange fills are marked against the same venue's quotes. OTC/broker trades are marked against the primary venue (ICE / ICE ENDEX / CME). USD uses `energy_usd_factor_asof` (px_factor × FX).

**What to look for:** **1, 3:** exchange curves should stay flat, with aggressive fills near minus the half-spread and passive fills near plus it. **2, 4, 5:** the *Utility/Industrial · oil* line drifting down is the adverse selection; it persists across days (t ≈ -3 to -4). **6-9** look like execution problems but aren't: stale strip quotes, a feed gap, booking lag, and amendments that break reconciliation with exchange fills.

*Console gotcha: don't name a CTE `lt`. The console reads it as `LT JOIN` and drops the `@day` variable.*

WITH m AS (
  SELECT h.offset/1000000000 AS horizon_s,
         f.venue || CASE WHEN f.passive THEN ' passive' ELSE ' aggressive' END AS series,
         sign(f.qty)*((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - f.px)/f.px*10000 AS bps
  FROM energy_fills f
  HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (f.symbol = q.symbol AND f.venue = q.source)
  LIST (0, 1s, 5s, 10s, 30s, 60s, 120s, 300s) AS h
  WHERE f.ts IN @day
)
SELECT horizon_s, series, avg(bps) AS markout_bps
FROM m GROUP BY horizon_s, series ORDER BY horizon_s, series
cells.name: 1 · Exchange fills: markout curve by venue & side (bps)

cells.value:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM energy_trade_events LATEST ON booked_ts PARTITION BY trade_id)
    WHERE status != 'CANCELLED' AND channel != 'EXCH' AND trade_ts IN @day ORDER BY trade_ts
  ) TIMESTAMP(trade_ts)
), m AS (
  SELECT h.offset/1000000 AS horizon_s,
         CASE WHEN t.counterparty LIKE 'UTILITY%' OR t.counterparty LIKE 'INDUSTRIAL%' THEN 'Utility/Industrial' ELSE 'Bank/Trader/Producer' END
         || CASE WHEN t.curve IN ('BRENT','WTI','GASOIL') THEN ' · oil' ELSE ' · gas/power/carbon' END AS segment,
         sign(t.qty)*((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px)/t.px*10000 AS bps
  FROM t
  HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND q.source != 'EEX')
  LIST (0, 60s, 120s, 300s, 600s, 900s, 1800s) AS h
)
SELECT horizon_s, segment, avg(bps) AS markout_bps FROM m GROUP BY horizon_s, segment ORDER BY horizon_s, segment
cells.name: 2 · OTC + broker: markout curve by counterparty type × complex (bps)

cells.value:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT h.offset/1000000000 AS sec, f.venue, f.passive, f.qty, f.px, q.bid, q.ask,
         sign(f.qty)*((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - f.px)/f.px*10000 AS bps
  FROM energy_fills f
  HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (f.symbol = q.symbol AND f.venue = q.source)
  LIST (0, 10s, 60s, 300s) AS h
  WHERE f.ts IN @day
)
SELECT venue, CASE WHEN passive THEN 'passive' ELSE 'aggressive' END AS side, count()/4 AS fills,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN sec=0 THEN (ask-bid)/2/((bid+ask)/2)*1e4 END), 2) AS half_spread_bps,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN sec=0 THEN bps END), 2) AS mo_0s,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN sec=10 THEN bps END), 2) AS mo_10s,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN sec=60 THEN bps END), 2) AS mo_1m,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN sec=300 THEN bps END), 2) AS mo_5m
FROM m GROUP BY venue, side ORDER BY venue, side
cells.name: 3 · Exchange fills scorecard (bps, venue mid)

WITH t AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM energy_trade_events LATEST ON booked_ts PARTITION BY trade_id)
    WHERE status != 'CANCELLED' AND channel != 'EXCH' AND trade_ts IN @day ORDER BY trade_ts
  ) TIMESTAMP(trade_ts)
), m AS (
  SELECT h.offset/1000000 AS sec, t.counterparty, t.curve, t.symbol, t.qty, t.px,
         sign(t.qty)*((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px)/t.px*10000 AS bps,
         t.qty*((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px) AS pnl_ccy
  FROM t
  HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND q.source != 'EEX')
  LIST (0, 60s, 300s, 900s) AS h
), u AS (SELECT m.*, m.pnl_ccy * f.factor AS usd FROM m JOIN energy_usd_factor_asof f ON f.symbol = m.symbol)
SELECT counterparty, count()/4 AS trades,
       sum(CASE WHEN sec=0 AND curve IN ('BRENT','WTI','GASOIL') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS oil_trades,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN sec=0 THEN bps END), 2) AS mo_0s_bps,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN sec=60 THEN bps END), 2) AS mo_1m_bps,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN sec=300 THEN bps END), 2) AS mo_5m_bps,
       round(avg(CASE WHEN sec=900 THEN bps END), 2) AS mo_15m_bps,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN sec=900 THEN usd END)) AS pnl_15m_usd
FROM u GROUP BY counterparty ORDER BY pnl_15m_usd
cells.name: 4 · OTC + broker counterparty scorecard (sorted by 15m USD)

WITH t AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM energy_trade_events LATEST ON booked_ts PARTITION BY trade_id)
    WHERE status != 'CANCELLED' AND channel != 'EXCH' ORDER BY trade_ts
  ) TIMESTAMP(trade_ts)
), m AS (
  SELECT t.trade_ts, t.symbol,
         CASE WHEN t.counterparty LIKE 'UTILITY%' OR t.counterparty LIKE 'INDUSTRIAL%' THEN 'Utility/Industrial' ELSE 'Bank/Trader/Producer' END AS cpty_type,
         CASE WHEN t.curve IN ('BRENT','WTI','GASOIL') THEN 'oil' ELSE 'gas/power/carbon' END AS complex,
         sign(t.qty)*((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px)/t.px*10000 AS bps,
         t.qty*((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px) AS pnl_ccy
  FROM t
  HORIZON JOIN (SELECT * FROM energy_quotes WHERE source IN ('ICE','ICE_ENDEX','CME')) q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol)
  LIST (900s) AS h
), u AS (SELECT m.*, m.pnl_ccy * f.factor AS usd FROM m JOIN energy_usd_factor_asof f ON f.symbol = m.symbol)
SELECT timestamp_floor('d', trade_ts) AS trade_date, complex, cpty_type, count() AS trades,
       round(avg(bps), 2) AS mo_15m_bps,
       round(avg(bps) / (stddev_samp(bps) / sqrt(count())), 1) AS t_stat,
       round(sum(usd)) AS pnl_15m_usd
FROM u GROUP BY trade_date, complex, cpty_type ORDER BY complex DESC, cpty_type DESC, trade_date
cells.name: 5 · Persistence: 15m markout by complex × counterparty type, every day

cells.value:
WITH legs AS (
  SELECT f.ts, f.trade_id, f.symbol, f.venue, f.passive, f.qty, f.px, m.symbol AS leg,
         cast(CASE WHEN s.complex = 'GAS' THEN m.days ELSE m.hours END AS double) AS w
  FROM energy_fills f
  JOIN energy_instruments s ON s.symbol = f.symbol
  JOIN energy_instruments m ON m.curve = s.curve AND m.granularity = 'M'
       AND m.delivery_start >= s.delivery_start AND m.delivery_end <= s.delivery_end
  WHERE f.ts IN @day AND s.granularity IN ('Q','S','Y')
  ORDER BY f.ts
), legs_t AS (SELECT * FROM legs TIMESTAMP(ts)),
leg_mids AS (SELECT legs_t.*, (q.bid+q.ask)/2 AS leg_mid FROM legs_t ASOF JOIN energy_quotes q ON (legs_t.leg = q.symbol AND legs_t.venue = q.source)),
fair AS (SELECT ts, trade_id, symbol, venue, passive, qty, px, sum(leg_mid*w)/sum(w) AS fair FROM leg_mids GROUP BY ts, trade_id, symbol, venue, passive, qty, px ORDER BY ts),
fair_t AS (SELECT * FROM fair TIMESTAMP(ts)),
k AS (SELECT fair_t.*, (q.bid+q.ask)/2 AS strip_mid, datediff('s', q.ts, fair_t.ts) AS quote_age_s FROM fair_t ASOF JOIN energy_quotes q ON (fair_t.symbol = q.symbol AND fair_t.venue = q.source))
SELECT venue, CASE WHEN passive THEN 'passive' ELSE 'aggressive' END AS side, count() AS fills,
  round(avg(quote_age_s), 1) AS avg_strip_quote_age_s, max(quote_age_s) AS max_strip_quote_age_s,
  round(avg(sign(qty)*(strip_mid - px)/px*1e4), 2) AS edge_vs_strip_quote_bps,
  round(avg(sign(qty)*(fair - px)/px*1e4), 2) AS edge_vs_month_legs_bps
FROM k GROUP BY venue, side ORDER BY venue, side
cells.name: 6 · NOT a pick-off: strip fills vs stale strip quote vs month-leg fair value

WITH s AS (
  SELECT ts, source, count() AS quotes FROM energy_quotes
  WHERE ts IN @day AND source != 'FX_FEED' SAMPLE BY 1m FILL(0)
)
SELECT source, ts AS silent_minute, quotes FROM s WHERE quotes = 0 ORDER BY source, ts
cells.name: 7 · Market-data feed gaps (minutes with zero quotes)

cells.value:
SELECT channel, booked_by, count() AS trades,
       round(avg(datediff('s', trade_ts, booked_ts)) / 60.0, 1) AS avg_lag_min,
       round(max(datediff('s', trade_ts, booked_ts)) / 60.0, 1) AS max_lag_min
FROM energy_trade_events
WHERE trade_ts IN @day AND version = 1
GROUP BY channel, booked_by ORDER BY channel, avg_lag_min DESC
cells.name: 8 · Booking lag by channel (minutes from trade to booking)

cells.value:
WITH e AS (SELECT * FROM energy_trade_events LATEST ON booked_ts PARTITION BY trade_id)
SELECT e.trade_ts, e.channel, e.counterparty, e.trader, e.symbol, e.status, e.reason,
       e.qty AS booked_qty, f.qty AS exchange_fill_qty, e.px AS booked_px, f.px AS exchange_fill_px,
       e.booked_ts, round(datediff('s', e.trade_ts, e.booked_ts) / 60.0, 1) AS lag_min,
       CASE WHEN f.qty IS NOT NULL AND (f.qty != e.qty OR f.px != e.px) THEN 'BREAK vs fills' ELSE '' END AS recon
FROM e LEFT JOIN energy_fills f ON f.trade_id = e.trade_id
WHERE e.trade_ts IN @day AND e.version > 1
ORDER BY e.trade_ts
cells.name: 9 · Amendments, cancels & reconciliation breaks vs exchange fills
